mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_allocation_lock(owner_id) VALUES(#{ownerId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=training_allocation_lock.owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT paper_id FROM assessment_task WHERE id=#{taskId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.employee_id FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=a.participant_id AND p.task_id=a.task_id JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN organization_employee e ON e.id=p.employee_id AND e.created_by=t.created_by WHERE t.created_by=#{ownerId} AND t.paper_id=#{paperId} AND a.status='SUBMITTED'
SELECT id FROM training WHERE id=#{trainingId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}
SELECT employee_id FROM learner_paper_binding WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND paper_id=#{paperId} AND JSON_CONTAINS(training_ids,CAST(#{trainingId} AS JSON))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learner_paper_binding(owner_id,employee_id,paper_id,training_ids) VALUES(#{ownerId},#{employeeId},#{paperId},JSON_ARRAY(#{trainingId})) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=learner_paper_binding.owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_CONTAINS(training_ids,CAST(#{trainingId} AS JSON)) FROM learner_paper_binding WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND employee_id=#{employeeId} AND paper_id=#{paperId} FOR UPDATE
